Welcome to your new Quarto blog post!

## Steps to Create a Quarto Blog

1. Install Quarto: https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/
2. Create a new project folder.
3. Add a `_quarto.yml` configuration file.
4. Create posts in the `posts/` directory, each in its own folder with an `index.qmd` file.
5. Customize your blog with themes and CSS.
6. Render your site with `quarto render`.

Happy blogging!
